_readme: List prices usage-snapshot.sh multiplies a session's token counts by — USD per million tokens.
TEMPLATE-OWNED and synced everywhere, so every repo prices its own lines identically and no
repo has to reach icm-board for a number. Filled from the claude-api skill's Current Models
table (cached 2026-06-24) and its prompt-caching reference (cache reads 0.1x input, 0.025x on
claude-fable-5-1; cache writes 1.25x input for the 5-minute TTL, 2x for the 1-hour TTL) — never
from memory. A model missing here prices as cost_usd=unknown, never as zero. Amend deliberately
in the template, bump as_of, and sync. A dated id (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) matches its
undated row; OpenCode sessions carry their own cost from models.dev and are recorded as-is.
